title: 7 倒计时07
content_zh:
倪夏这两天全妆的频率比一整年都高，手法生疏，工具缺失，以至于她始终觉得妆效不够好。
确认社交距离看不出脸上有什么瑕疵后，倪夏给游决发了条消息说自己到了，随即开门下车。
等会儿进了他办公室，干脆就假装惊讶地发现那幅画，然后问游决，为什么会把她的画像摆在办公室。
待游决的心意昭然若揭，无法嘴硬，堵在他们之间的阻碍便冰消瓦解。
倪夏再顺势表达自己的意愿，抛出橄榄枝，两人岂不是就可以水银泻地般奔向富裕的海洋？
倪夏脑内琢磨得起劲，走到电梯间时，正好看见两个工装男人搬着一个大箱子出来。
倪夏直接将手机揣回包里，随即大步跨进电梯，抵达楼层后，毫不犹豫地朝他办公室走去。
办公桌前的游决注意力尽在电脑上，并未回头，不甚在意地说了句“请进”。
但随着来人推门而入，或许是独属于女人的轻柔气息，又或是说不清道不明的预感，游决敲击键盘的手指顿住，下意识瞥了眼对面的沙发。
倪夏没说话，不可置信地转头盯着空荡荡的沙发，好一会儿，凝滞的神色才渐渐松动，以目光搜索这间办公室。
空间不大，所有东西一览无余，文书繁复而有序地挤满了柜子桌子，墙面更是没有容纳一幅巨画的空间。
游决那头倒是快速搞定了手头的工作，将资料一收，起身道：“跟我来。”
游决更是从进来后就没说过话，先将身后的显示屏打开，接上电脑，又坐下整理手里的合同。
不是什么正式场合，他只穿了白衬衫，没系领带，袖口挽起一截，手上动作干净利落，脸上神情泰然自若，给了倪夏十足的踏实感。
见他抬头看过来，倪夏继续说道：“当时全班同学都去操场玩儿了，我回教室拿东西，看见你一个人在座位上看书。”
她笑了笑，“还有很多同学打打闹闹经过，你一点儿没受影响，你简直是我见过的专注力最强的人。”
content_en:
Ni Xia has put on full makeup more frequently in the past two days than she has in the whole year. Her technique is unfamiliar and the tools are missing, so she always feels that the makeup effect is not good enough.
After confirming that no blemishes on his face could be seen due to social distance, Ni Xia sent a message to You Jue saying that he had arrived, and then opened the door and got out of the car.
When I entered his office later, I simply pretended to be surprised to find the painting, and then asked You Jue why her portrait was placed in the office.
Waiting for You Jue's intention to be clear, unable to speak hard, the obstacles between them disappeared.
If Ni Xia takes advantage of the opportunity to express her wishes and extends an olive branch, won't the two of them be able to rush towards the ocean of wealth like mercury pouring down the earth?
Ni Xia was thinking hard in her mind. When she walked to the elevator, she happened to see two men in overalls carrying a large box.
Ni Xia put the phone back into her bag and strode into the elevator. After arriving on the floor, she walked towards his office without hesitation.
You Jue, who was at the desk, focused all his attention on the computer. He didn't look back and said "come in" nonchalantly.
But as someone pushed open the door and entered, perhaps it was the gentle breath that belonged to a woman, or an indescribable premonition, You Jue's fingers on the keyboard paused, and he subconsciously glanced at the sofa opposite.
Ni Xia didn't speak. She turned her head and stared at the empty sofa in disbelief. After a while, her stagnant expression gradually loosened and she searched the office with her eyes.
The space is not big, everything can be seen at a glance, the cabinets and tables are crowded with complicated and orderly documents, and there is no space on the wall to accommodate a huge painting.
On the other hand, You Jue quickly finished the work at hand, put away the materials, stood up and said, "Follow me."
You Jue has not spoken since he came in. He first opened the display screen behind him, connected it to the computer, and then sat down to sort out the contract in his hand.
It was not a formal occasion. He only wore a white shirt and no tie. His cuffs were rolled up, his hands were clean and neat, and his face looked calm and composed, which gave Ni Xia a sense of solidity.
Seeing him looking up, Ni Xia continued: "At that time, the whole class went to the playground to play. I went back to the classroom to get my things and saw you reading alone in your seat."
She smiled and said, "There were many classmates who were having fun passing by, but you were not affected at all. You are simply the most focused person I have ever seen."
